description: Generic document templating: ${...} placeholder substitution with an explicit missing marker (never a guessed value), plus a starter set of legal letter templates. Independent of any legal-specific package.

objects.name: render_template
objects.description: Substitutes ${path.to.var} placeholders in a template text from a JSON variables object. Missing variables are left as an explicit [var missing] marker, never guessed. Pure function: no filesystem or host tool/service calls.

variables.description: Nested JSON object resolved by dotted path, e.g. {"dossier": {"client": "..."}}
